repos.name: earlgreyhot1701D
repos.description: Public servant building AI tools that help systems explain themselves. Clew Suite builder · NACM speaker. Structure first, wonder second.

repos.name: heimdall
repos.description: Reproducible least-privilege test of RBAC at an AI gateway. Three scoped roles against three model tiers, nine calls, plus a falsification test and a negative control. Every claim traces to a line in an append-only log. Bifrost, run locally by someone who administers court access roles for a living.

repos.name: charitas-clew
repos.description: Charitas Clew is a mobile-first, zero-judgment public rights engine. It ingests intimidating bureaucratic notices (eviction notices, utility shutoffs, benefit recertifications, court summons), deconstructs them using Gemini Flash, and outputs plain-language explanations, clear deadline alerts, and actionable step-by-step guidance.

repos.name: porch-light
repos.description: City agendas are public, findable, and unreadable. Porch Light reads Ventura's every week and tells one person what changed, in English and Spanish, with a receipt on every claim. It drafts the shape of a public comment. You write the stance and you send it.

repos.name: Clew-Directive
repos.description: AI education is overwhelming — thousands of courses, most behind paywalls, few personalized. Clew Directive cuts through it. 4 questions, a personalized learning path from verified free resources, a PDF you keep forever. No signup. No data stored. Multi-agent system (Scout + Navigator + Curator) on AWS serverless. Free, private, accessible to all.

repos.name: hot-ar-summer-2026
repos.description: 33 small deterministic web apps, built and shipped daily through July 2026 for Netlify's Hot AR Summer. One self-contained HTML file each. No build step, no dependencies, no Math.random in any selection logic. Same input, same output, with the derivation shown. The whole month cost $44, and the write-up shows the receipts.

repos.name: nova-trivium
repos.description: A trivium is where three roads meet. This one routes every customer message to exactly one of three behaviors: collect a bug report and file it to DynamoDB via an AgentCore Gateway tool, answer from an embedded FAQ, or hand off to a human. Built on the Amazon Bedrock AgentCore managed harness. The routing is prompt engineering, not plumbing.

repos.name: sobremesa
repos.description: DEV.to Frontend Challenge entry, Comfort Food Edition. Sobremesa is Spanish for the time you stay at the table after the food is gone. Six meals, six Mexican cities, fourteen years, measured in minutes. Single static HTML page, zero dependencies, zero tracking, WCAG AA contrast computed rather than eyeballed.

repos.name: civiq
repos.description: Reads city meeting agendas and rewrites them in plain language you can search. Every result cites its page and links to the source. Never scores, ranks, or grades any agency. Prototype covering Ventura, California.

repos.name: clew-chronicles
repos.description: Clew Chronicles is a longitudinal study of 13 months of AI-assisted building—tracking repositories, writing, hackathons, and evolving architecture to examine what changed, how model authority shifted, and what the public record says about one self-taught builder’s journey.

repos.name: Clew-Labs
repos.description: Clew Labs is the editorial home for L. Cordero and the Clew Suite of AI-assisted developer tools. Tools that help systems explain themselves. From courtroom to codebase. Built static, deployed on Replit.

repos.name: themis-lex
repos.description: Themis Lex is a plain-English AI readiness check for California court staff. Tell it your role and workflow, get back what AI can help with and what it must never touch, as a PDF you can hand to your supervisor. Built solo in three weeks.

repos.name: second-squeeze
repos.description: Model archaeology on Lemonade: a 2019 model (GPT-2 XL) vs a 2025 model (Qwen3) on one laptop. The smaller, newer one runs ~11x faster on the same CPU. My reproducible benchmark even caught my own first headline as a bad run. It wasn't the hardware, it was the models. Live dashboard. AMD Lemonade Challenge.

repos.name: verity-lex
repos.description: Verity Lex is an AI agent that reads a public institution's public record and returns an auditable AI-readiness surface: what the evidence shows, what can't be seen, every claim cited. A deterministic rule engine anchored to California law does the scoring, never the model. Built with GPT-5.6 + Tavily. Evidence, not verdict.

repos.name: real-door
repos.description: Renter-side application-readiness copilot for affordable housing. Turns synthetic documents into a human-confirmed profile, explains one program's rules with citations, flags missing or expired items, and prepares a renter-controlled packet. Deterministic math, not verdicts. Assistive, never adjudicative. Next.js + Bedrock.

repos.name: daybreak
repos.description: Daybreak is an always-on AWS agent that wakes on a schedule, scans all your GitHub repos with Amazon Bedrock (Nova Lite), and emails you a short brief: what is live, what has gone quiet, what needs a README. Serverless: EventBridge Scheduler + Lambda + SES. Read-only, it reports and you decide. Built for the AWS Weekend Agent Challenge.

repos.name: justicia-clew
repos.description: Justicia Clew gives plain-language jury duty answers in your court's own words. Live demo for Santa Barbara County, built on FastAPI and DigitalOcean Gradient AI agents grounded in official court sites. Independent, not affiliated with any court. MLH x DigitalOcean hackathon project.

repos.name: north-star
repos.description: An AI powered decision assistant that brings structure to difficult choices. North Star compares opportunities against your personal goals, strengths, constraints, and priorities to deliver an Alignment Score with transparent reasoning. Built with Next.js, AWS Lambda, Amazon Bedrock Nova Lite, API Gateway, and CloudWatch.

repos.name: madame-minou
repos.description: Madame Minou is a French cat astrologer who reads your cat's stars: a deterministic birth chart underneath, her warm franglais voice on top. A behavior decoder for the people who love their cats and can't quite figure them out. Café-terrace-at-night, Van Gogh idiom. Built for Hack the Kitty 2026. "Are cats even real?"

repos.name: perseus-clew
repos.description: AgentisLux shows you what retrieval agents (ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI overviews) see when they read your site's raw HTML. For your second audience. Live at agentislux.io.

repos.name: argus-clew
repos.description: Agent readiness prompts for AWS. Three copy-paste prompts that help developers detect structural issues that make web apps hard for AI agents to interpret. Argus Clew scans every commit via CodePipeline. Argus Clew Deploy preserves machine readability on S3/CloudFront. Argus Clew Audit runs a one-time review with no infrastructure required.

repos.name: vigil-crest
repos.description: A Telegram correspondent that watches the DEV Community challenge feed and helps you decide whether to jump into a new challenge. Built on Hermes Agent and AWS Bedrock: deterministic change detection feeds the AI judgment, and verdicts hedge honestly until the agent has watched enough of your real decisions to earn its confidence.

repos.name: petit-mot
repos.description: Mobile-first French learning app. Daily flashcards, story read-alongs, and narrated audio journal, all set in Paris. Art Nouveau aesthetic. Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, no framework, no backend. 5-year-old reading level in 30 days. Built with Kiro + Claude. AI assisted. Human approved. Powered by NLP.

repos.name: vidi-clew
repos.description: A prompt I wrote during Code with Claude Extended that turns Claude Code into a plain-language workshop helper for non-technical builders. Born from getting stuck at "clone the repo." Adapts to other AI-in-IDE tools with small edits.

repos.name: readme-clew
repos.description: README Clew audits your GitHub repo for drift between what your README claims and what your code does. Paste a public repo URL. Claude extracts every checkable claim. Five verifiers check each one against your code. Findings only — no rewrites, no grading, nothing saved. Audit your own receipts. Built for the Replit 10 Year Buildathon.

repos.name: steep
repos.description: A deliberately useless tea leaf reading app for GitHub repos. Paste a URL, get a dramatic, wildly specific, and entirely unhelpful divination of your codebase. Powered by Gemini, tasseography, and poor judgment. Built for the DEV April Fools Challenge 2026. This is a teapot. It cannot brew coffee. 🫖

repos.name: permission-to-approach-the-firewall
repos.description: AI-powered cybersecurity awareness program for court staff. Built with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Claude, and NotebookLM for the Founderz AI Skills 4 Women Open Challenge. Three deliverables: phishing scenario library, incident response decision tree, and monthly micro-briefings. Role-specific. Non-punitive. Ready to deploy.

repos.name: hermes-clew
repos.description: AI agents can't use most web apps — they can't find buttons, fill forms, or navigate. Hermes Clew scans your HTML/JSX/TSX files and tells you exactly what's broken and how to fix it, scored 0-100. Lives in GitLab Duo Chat. Just ask it to scan. Built on Anthropic Claude.

repos.name: beyondthedocket
repos.description: Beyond the Docket is a cinematic AI Builder portfolio bridging civic tech and innovation. Built with Vite, Express, and Gemini 2.0 Flash, it features an automated Case Study Generator and technical walkthroughs. Designed for high-impact developers, it combines glassmorphism aesthetics with automated GitHub insights to showcase complexity velocity

repos.name: anton-clew
repos.description: Anton Clew is a policy-driven CLI that adds deterministic safety guardrails to AI-assisted coding workflows. It classifies file changes as DENY, NEEDS_APPROVAL, or ALLOW based on repository policies, providing predictable, test-backed enforcement instead of probabilistic AI judgments.

repos.name: memoria-clew
repos.description: Memoria Clew is a local-first developer research memory. Save newsletters, articles, tools, and URLs, seed context from your projects, and recall past research when it aligns with your current work. Manual scans, explainable logic, no background jobs.

repos.name: clew-quest
repos.description: Intelligent open source project discovery powered by Algolia Agent Studio. Answer 4 questions about what you want to learn and your skill level. Get GitHub projects with AI-generated explanations for why each matches your goals. Semantic search + Gemini reasoning = smarter project recommendations.

repos.name: Athena-Clew
repos.description: Athena Clew Platform - Theseus Autonomous Debugging Agent  Gemini 3 Hackathon submission. Theseus uses deep thinking to analyze errors, search your debugging history, extract reusable principles, and learn autonomously. Built as part of the Athena unified developer platform ecosystem.

repos.name: lumen-clew
repos.description: Lumen Clew helps developers understand their codebase through gentle, educational feedback—not judgment. Scan any public GitHub repository and get insights across 4 areas.

repos.name: lumen-clew-backend
repos.description: Lumen Clew backend server (Render deployment)

repos.name: metis-clew
repos.description: Helps anyone understand AI-generated code by showing full context (WHAT/HOW/WHY) and learning which explanations actually work. Validated through user research. MVP built in 5 weeks.

repos.name: janus-clew
repos.description: Janus Clew: Evidence-backed growth tracking for developers.  Analyzes your repositories using Amazon AgentCore to measure  coding complexity, track skill progression, and prove your growth  objectively. Built for AWS Global Vibe Hackathon 2025.

repos.name: vibe-coding-prompt-template
repos.description: Templates and workflow for generating PRDs, Tech Designs, and MVP code using LLMs and AI IDEs

repos.name: Ariadne-Clew
repos.description: Ariadne Clew is a context engine and reasoning agent for LLM-native builders. It transforms raw chat logs into structured memory artifacts, preserving aha moments, MVP changes, scope creep, README notes, and post-MVP ideas. Built on AWS (Agentcore Runtime, Amazon Bedrock, Claude Sonnet 4) with strict QA guardrails.

repos.name: ticketglass
repos.description: AI-Powered IT Support Transparency Customers can finally see what's happening with their IT support tickets—no more black box.  Real-time updates, context-aware explanations, never repeated solutions.  Built with AWS Bedrock + Claude AI for SuperHack 2025.

repos.name: Panoptes-Scout
repos.description: Built for the Google AI Agents Intensive capstone hackathon, Panoptes Scout is a first pass data quality briefing agent for tabular datasets that runs compact pandas checks and is shaped to plug cleanly into the Google Agent Development Kit ADK.

repos.name: Sprint-Kit
repos.description: Project planner for middle schoolers teaching real PM skills: Break It Down, Time It Takes, Team Up, What I Learned. AI scaffolds task breakdown. Authentic badges. Zero data collection. Gold Standard PBL aligned. Safety-first. Built for CS Girlies hackathon.

repos.name: write-of-access
repos.description: Write of Access is a public-sector proof of concept using Amazon Textract to extract typed and handwritten data from scanned court forms. This repo includes sample inputs, output files, preprocessing scripts, and a validation template to support civic technologists exploring AI-enabled document workflows.

repos.name: hung-jury
repos.description: Prototype automation of the California Jury Data Report (JDR). Explored PDF parsing, JSON mapping, and QC validation before concluding vendor data corruption blocks full automation. Shows initiative, technical skill, and professional judgment in knowing when to stop.

repos.name: 12-angry-rows
repos.description: A data pipeline for analyzing jury panel utilization in California trial courts.

repos.name: your-honor-i-object-to-jury-duty-v9
repos.description: Proof-of-concept chatbot for jury eligibility using CA legal code and AWS Bedrock

repos.name: clew-forge
repos.description: Where your reasoning threads become real artifacts.   A lightweight project framework for indie builders, hackathons, and teams shipping real things fast—without sacrificing clarity. Start with 3 files. Ship in 48 hours. Scale when you need to.

repos.name: ai-devkit
repos.description: A CLI toolkit for AI-assisted software development with structured phase templates and environment setup for Cursor and Claude Code.

repos.name: The-Accidental-CTO
repos.description: How I Scaled from Zero to a Million Store on Dukaan,  Without a CS Degree.  .. A System Design Handbook by  Subhash Choudhary

repos.name: proof-of-scoville
repos.description: 🌶️ Mobile prototype that puts salsa on-chain. Using Xion’s DAVE SDK, it tracks and verifies spicy condiments — from salsa macha to chili crisps — built for the Proof of Concept 2025 Hackathon .

repos.name: team-110-customized-tutoring
repos.description: AWS AI Camp 2025 - Customized Tutoring

repos.name: ccc-ai-pdf-project
repos.description: Beginner Python project from CCC AI Summer Camp that extracts and structures PDF text for LLM-based tutoring support.

repos.name: aws-bedrock-streamlit-chat
repos.description: Streamlit-based Bedrock chatbot prototype. Forked for CCC AI Summer Camp to explore simple public-sector Q&A tools for jurors or internal training use cases.

repos.name: ai-summercamp-scripts
repos.description: Learning scripts and walkthrough examples for CCC AI Summer Camp. Used to understand how to call Bedrock foundation models (like Claude) using Python and boto3.

repos.name: aws-bedrock-vector-embeddings
repos.description: Exploring vector embeddings using Amazon Bedrock. Forked for CCC AI Summer Camp to support learning in semantic search, public-sector retrieval systems, and policy document access.

repos.name: orcutt-schools-chatbot
repos.description: Forked for CCC AI Camp reflection and public-sector adaptation review

repos.name: a-treatise-in-one-night
repos.description: A first-person exploration of AI concepts, model behavior, and human learning. Written as a structured late-night reckoning.
